evals.name: feature-plan-with-wireframe
evals.prompt: Plan this feature before building it. We need a task inbox dashboard for a project management tool. Users should see a list of tasks grouped by project, be able to filter by status (todo/in progress/done), quick-create a task, and see a summary bar at the top showing counts. It should handle loading, empty, and error states. Desktop only for now. Show me the plan.

assertions.text: Output includes a primary layout wireframe drawn with box-drawing characters
Wireframe covers at least loading, empty, and error states
Systems plan includes Components, Data Flow, API Surface, State, Edge Cases, and Dependencies subsections
Output includes a feature brief of 3-5 sentences with success criteria
Wireframe regions are annotated with connections to systems plan sections
Does not produce implementation code — stays in planning phase
Mentions writing or updating FEATURE_PLAN.md with the plan and wireframe

evals.name: sync-check-plan-and-wireframe
evals.prompt: Plan a user profile settings page before coding. Users can edit display name, email, avatar upload, notification preferences (email/push/both), and delete account. It's a single-page form with sections. Include loading when fetching current settings, a dirty/unsaved state, validation errors, a saving state, and a success confirmation. Also handle the case where the settings endpoint returns a 403. Show me the plan first.

assertions.text: Every state mentioned in the prompt (loading, dirty, validation error, saving, success, 403) appears in the wireframes
Systems plan API Surface section names at least one endpoint for fetching and one for saving settings
Edge Cases section addresses the 403 permission denied case
Wireframe shows visual grouping of form sections (display name, email, avatar, notifications, danger zone)
Records a selected DESIGN.md path and its DNA dimensions under Visual Language section
Does not produce implementation code — stays in planning phase
